name: Lierne
description: A lierne rib — a short one that ties two main ribs together and carries nothing.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @shape(points: 6; rotate: 30; scale: 0.96; frame: @pick(9, 16)); clip-path: @shape(points: 6; rotate: 30; scale: 0.96; frame: @pick(9, 16)); -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
